turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Sure. Quick reminder: in the present simple, we add -s to the verb after he, she and it (She works). Verbs ending in -ch, -sh, -s, -x or -o take -es (He watches).

Let's start easy: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. Write only the verb.
